Dear [Miss Medhurst](../persons.html#988)
Many thanks for your little books.
I dare say you will go on and prosper

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Although it is impossible to date this note precisely or identify the \'little books\', Medhurst\'s association with CMY and MP dates from 1874-1890.
